title: Managing Supply and Demand
overview: This course leverages Cesim’s ‘SimFirm’ simulation tool to replicate real-world competitive and operational decision-making scenarios faced by managers. SimFirm is a comprehensive business management simulation that integrates core functional areas such as production, marketing, and logistics, providing participants with a hands-on experience of managing a company from a general management perspective. The simulation covers a range of concepts, linking various management disciplines—marketing, production, logistics, and financial decision-making—while situating the organization within the broader business environment and its stakeholders.
audience: This course is ideal for managers and business professionals involved in strategic planning and departmental decision-making, as well as those overseeing core business operations or holding management and supervisory roles in support functions.
methodology: The course uses a web-based simulation with an intuitive graphical interface where participants make strategic decisions. Teams will be tasked with managing the sales and operations of an international pharmaceutical company.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Gain a comprehensive understanding of running a business from a general management perspective
Recognize how different companies and external factors interact within a complex, interconnected environment
Analyze and forecast market trends, using insights to make informed, goal-oriented decisions
Apply data-driven decision-making techniques, linking decisions to financial outcomes and overall performance
Work effectively in teams, utilizing collaborative problem-solving methods in a rapidly changing market
